versions.name: Fire Safety
versions.description: Learn the fire tetrahedron and how heat moves, pick the right extinguisher for each class of fire, inspect a home for hazards, run a family fire drill, and build and safely put out a campfire.

provenance.notes: Introduction year (and BSA number where absent) backfilled from the USSSP merit badge history table; for a renamed badge this is when THIS name took effect, not when the lineage began.
